author: Jdthomas24
description: Advanced Hubitat battery monitoring with analytics, trends and replacement tracking. Recurring scan schedule, confidence-weighted health, EWMA smoothing.
releaseNotes: v2.6.0 is a major UI refresh with phone-friendly pages, a Needs attention list, and a matching web portal. Adds Li-ion cliff-drop alerts and automatic detection of dead-battery swaps. Fixes bulk actions skipping combined actions and history sorting across years.
